title: Contraceptive implant
what: The doctor places a small, flexible rod under the skin on the inner upper arm. It releases a hormone and prevents pregnancy for several years.
why: When you want reliable protection for years without daily pills.
duration: placement usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; it usually works for 3 years, some types longer. Check which you have
tell_doctor: If you are or might be pregnant
Blood clots, liver disease, or breast cancer
What medicines you take. Some make the implant less effective
Allergy to painkillers or numbing medicine

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: It is usually placed in the first days of your period. Then protection starts right away. Check with your doctor.

prepare.title: Arm
prepare.text: It usually goes in the arm you use less.

bring: The date of your last period
steps: You lie down, with your arm bent and placed behind your head
The doctor finds a spot on the inner upper arm and marks it
The skin is cleaned and numbed with a shot
The rod is placed under the skin with a special applicator. It takes a few seconds
The doctor feels that the rod is in place and lets you feel it too
The spot is covered with a plaster and a tight bandage
feel: You usually do not feel the placement, just pressure
Afterward, the spot may ache, and a bruise can appear
after: The tight bandage usually comes off after a day, the plaster after 3 to 5 days
Periods may become irregular, lighter, or stop. This is common and usually safe
Write down the date the implant needs replacing
It can be removed at any time through a tiny cut with numbing
red_flags: Redness, pus, and pain at the spot, or a fever
You cannot feel the rod under your skin: see a doctor, and use condoms

faq.a: Usually not. It is under the skin. You can feel it with your fingers.

faq.q: What will happen to my periods?
faq.a: For many people they change: lighter, irregular, or they stop. If it bothers you a lot, tell your doctor.

faq.q: How soon can I get pregnant after removal?
faq.a: Usually quickly, even in the first month.

reminders.text: Implant placement tomorrow. Remember the date of your last period, and bring your medicine list.
